analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong growth in Q1 FY27, driven by the expansion of its offline business and new branches. The company has successfully launched its digital platform, AkikoPay, on both Android and iOS, and plans to integrate insurance and mutual funds in the near future. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upward to INR 325 crores to INR 350 crores and expects to maintain a 70% to 100% CAGR over the next three years. Additionally, the company has no plans for fundraising over the next year as bank support remains strong. Akiko Global Services Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹6,812.2 lakh and profit after tax of ₹701.6 lakh for Q1 FY27.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance to between INR 325 crores and INR 350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects its CAGR to remain at 70% to 100% year-on-year for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving a 9% to 11% PAT margin for the current year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year. If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach around INR 1,000 crores in disbursements by the end of December.
guidance.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore in FY27 with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue growth of 70% to 100% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Akiko Global aims to build INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: The company expects AkikoPay to contribute around INR 50 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Management targets growing the unsecured loan book to INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

guidance.claim: The company expects full-year FY27 revenue to exceed INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: I am looking forward for this quarter with good quarter numbers, INR65 crores to INR70 crores with good margins.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees good visibility for upcoming quarters due to strong bank partnerships and a healthy sourcing pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: AkikoPay is receiving a daily average of 200 to 300 credit leads for loans and credit cards.
demand_outlook.quote: On AkikoPay, credit leads coming in such as for loans and credit cards, if I look at the daily average, we are getting 200 to 300 leads.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently the fastest-growing loan product for the company.
Digital credit card sourcing accounts for approximately 70% of total sourcing.
demand_outlook.quote: The most important thing is that almost 70% of sourcing is now happening digitally, which is improving productivity and making customer acquisition costs better, and targeting capabilities are also becoming stronger.

demand_outlook.claim: Lead conversion improves from 10% digitally to 60%-80% with physical branch presence.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue from Dubai operations reached INR 1 crore in April and is expected to reach INR 1.25 crores in May.
demand_outlook.quote: Right now, our revenue from Dubai in February was INR50 lakhs, it has reached INR1 crores in April. I am expecting it will reach INR1.25 crores in May.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open branches in Indore and Kerala over the next two to three months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: All of the company's branches are on rent or lease, with none being owned.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: The iOS version of the AkikoPay platform is currently under development and expected to launch in the coming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: Akiko Global has expanded its physical branch presence to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent approximately INR 1 crore on technology infrastructure for AkikoPay so far.
capex_expansion.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it.

capex_expansion.claim: Mutual funds and insurance products are expected to go live by August following IRDAI licensing.
capex_expansion.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

margins_costs.claim: The company will not incur unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: We will not incur any unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay.

margins_costs.claim: Branches opened in multiple cities have started contributing to profitability after causing slight stress in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: As I mentioned last time, our profit faced slight stress last quarter because we opened several branches across multiple cities. This time, those branches have contributed to profitability, enabling us to deliver good growth this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay enables customer acquisition at approximately 40% lower acquisition cost compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: Efficient Customer Acquisition: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn for AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: Disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 margins were impacted by investments in branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and AkikoPay scale-up.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Dubai operations faced margin pressure due to geopolitical tensions in the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains a conservative PAT margin target of 9% to 11% for FY27.
margins_costs.quote: So that's why I have been very conservative and kept it between 9% to 11%. I'm talking about PAT margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current team includes 16 people on the tech side, around 700 on sales, and around 50 on the backend.
orders_capacity.quote: Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people. And the rest are our management staff.

orders_capacity.claim: During Q1 FY27, monthly loan disbursals reached over ₹450 crore and monthly credit card sourcing reached 17,000–18,000 cards.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has cumulatively sourced over 15 lakh credit cards.
Akiko Global reached a monthly loan disbursement run rate exceeding INR 400 crores with an annualized book of INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: The loan book is split into INR 320 crores of unsecured loans and INR 80 crores of secured loans.
orders_capacity.quote: Unsecured book is INR320 crores, rest is secured book.

orders_capacity.claim: The total combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no plans for fundraising for the next six months to a year as banks are supporting them well.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days have decreased to 110 days and are expected to fall below 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is continuing to invest in technology, digital capabilities, and customer experience.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to invest in technology, digital capabilities and customer experience while maintaining a disciplined approach towards scalable and profitable growth.

capital_allocation.claim: Akiko Global plans to expand its loan business through unsecured loans without raising additional funds.
capital_allocation.quote: So we have decided that if we can grow business more from unsecured without any fund-raise, we have more potential, then this year we will go towards unsecured business rather than a secured business.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is not adopting a cash-burn fintech model for AkikoPay.
capital_allocation.quote: And one thing I would like to clearly say here, we are not building any cash-burn fintech model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Total revenue from the Dubai business was limited to INR 1.25 crores in the quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced some compliance-related issues on the App Store for its financial app.
risks_headwinds.quote: There were some compliance-related issues on the App Store -- since it's a financial app, compliance involves certain requirements.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced a slight hold on its tech side, which has since been resolved.
risks_headwinds.quote: There was a slight hold on our tech side, but that has been resolved as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues around the Iran region caused temporary revenue and margin pressure on Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

risks_headwinds.claim: AkikoPay experienced delays in launching on iOS due to App Store compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: We haven't even started the expansion yet because it is still pending on the App Store, due to some compliance.

management_commitments.quote: When I gave you guidance for FY27 of INR300 crore to INR325 crore, I am very confident we will achieve that number for sure.
